title: Better Default Zombies
description:
My take on Minecraft's zombies.
Currently, it only adds one mob, the slow zombie. This mod is in very early development
body:
# Minecraft's zombies are boring, let's fix that.
This mod plans to add a series of new mobs.

# CURRENT MOBS

[Slow Zombies]

Revamps Minecraft's default zombie, making it reasonably slow while also reducing its hit range. But don't be fooled, this zombie has one heavy hit and is also **_very_** persistent.

![(Currently retains the default zombie texture.)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6fce41e8d4c008ef281207119674b4e1be7416ed.png)
## PLANNED MOBS

### Overworld
* slow zombie ✔ (information already added above.)
* fast zombie (not a runner) ❌
* crawler (two default variations planned) ❌
* biter (when the zombie bites you, it freezes you in place for a sec and inflicts you with poison and/or nausea) ❌

### Nether
> * scorched zombie ❌(with its scorched skin, it's desperate to take control of a victim, resulting in a quick yet weak enemy)
> * magma zombie ❌(lava visually courses through it's vains, resulting in it inflicting fire upon its enemies.)
> * Hell Crawler ❌(unlike the normal crawler, this one is much faster due to it's shockingly strong arms)

### The End
> * Ender Zombie (basically he can teleport.) ❌



----
Since the mod currently doesn't disable the default zombie on its own, I recommend using [You Shall Not Spawn (YSNS)](https://modrinth.com/mod/you-shall-not-spawn)

You can either edit the disabled_entities.json5 file yourself or just paste [this](https://www.mediafire.com/file/xzvv78ase6ga9ys/disabled_entities.json5/file) into the ysnp config folder.
(mediafire link)
(Note: Disabling certain mobs is extremely easy, so either method works perfectly fine.)
